chapters.name: I · A signal in the dark
chapters.description: A single light becomes an identity. Quiet, spacious and unmistakably deliberate.

chapters.name: II · One becomes many
chapters.description: The same signal unfolds through every layout; symmetry gradually fills the room.

chapters.name: III · Light becomes matter
chapters.description: Ripples, time reversal and colour turn patterns into something tactile.

chapters.name: IV · The identity awakens
chapters.description: The film moves inside the Version1 mark. Materials, choreography, depth and flight become the main characters.

chapters.name: V · The human signal
chapters.description: An apparently synthetic world reveals its human input. Movement becomes the instrument.

chapters.name: VI · The singularity
chapters.description: All the languages combine: the fastest, richest and most layered passage of the show.

chapters.name: VII · Return to the source
chapters.description: Space returns. The mark stands upright, becomes familiar, and finally disappears into silence.
